en-US: Add beta editable mind map and flowchart notes with faster creation, interactive connections, automatic layout, keyboard controls, and theme palettes.
Let Paw learn notebook and tag preferences within the current workspace, with clearer discovery notifications and controls.
Make plugin setup more predictable by consolidating scheduling in plugin settings, clarifying network access labels, and avoiding shared GitHub asset rate limits.
Show account-wide desktop synchronization failures in Sync Issues so failures outside the open notebook are no longer hidden.
Stop newly typed text after a link from unintentionally inheriting the hyperlink.
zh-CN: 新增 Beta 可编辑思维导图与流程图笔记，支持快捷创建、交互连线、自动布局、键盘操作和主题配色。
Paw 可在当前工作区内学习笔记本与标签偏好，并提供更清晰的发现通知与控制。
将定时设置统一收纳到插件设置，明确网络访问标识，并规避共享 GitHub 资产限流，让插件配置更稳定可预期。
在“同步问题”中显示账户范围的桌面同步失败，避免当前笔记本之外的失败被隐藏。
修复在链接后继续输入时新文本意外继承超链接的问题。
